definitions.explanation: the mental strength or determination to accomplish something

examples.japanese: {気力|きりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}いて→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧きた。
{気力|きりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I overcame it through sheer willpower.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気力|きりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: My spirit is low because of illness.

examples.japanese: {気力|きりょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Both mental and physical strength are necessary.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers to mental energy, motivation, or willpower as opposed to physical strength (⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気力|きりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧ - to feel motivated
- {気力|きりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ - to lose motivation
- {気力|きりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}る→振り絞る：12817_furishiboru⟧ - to summon one's willpower
- {気力|きりょく}⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧ - full of spirit

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧ - physical strength
- ⟦{精神力|せいしんりょく}→精神力：17976_seishinryoku⟧ - mental strength
- ⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧ - motivation
